verdict.rationale: Daily's Pipecat Cloud pricing page states that Pipecat Cloud "supports unlimited concurrency" and offers agent profiles for different compute needs. The GitHub README says agents can be distributed across processes and machines. Together these address scaling without capacity requests, but this rests on a single marketing-level claim rather than detailed documented limits. Missing for 10: detailed concurrency/scaling docs (per-account caps, autoscaling behavior, cold-start or warm-pool guidance), self-hosted scaling guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration of high simultaneous call counts.
